subject: Renewal billing: convert Arcadia Health to Marketplace for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Megan Trussell <megan.trussell@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:02:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal billing: convert Arcadia Health to Marketplace for upcoming renewal

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you are well. Our renewal for the Redwood contract is coming up on July 15 and our procurement team asked whether we can switch to AWS Marketplace billing for this renewal instead of the direct invoice path we currently have. They prefer marketplace-based invoicing for centralized chargeback and compliance reasons.

A few quick questions to help them assess feasibility:
- Do we need an amendment to the current SOW to move to marketplace billing, or can the renewal itself be processed as a marketplace listing?
- Are there SKU equivalents for our current commitment so we maintain price parity?
- What is the earliest cutover date you can support for invoices to be routed through Marketplace?
- Any legal/PO changes we should plan for (DocuSign, PO updates)?

Our procurement lead is Daniel Park (cc'd on future replies). We are targeting minimal disruption to revenue recognition and our finance team wants a clear cutover plan with dates and owner responsibilities.

Could you share a short plan and availability for a 30-minute call next week?

Thanks,
Megan Trussell
VP, Strategic Procurement
Arcadia Health

Attachment: procurement_form.pdf (stub)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Megan Trussell <megan.trussell@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal billing: convert Arcadia Health to Marketplace for upcoming renewal

Hi Megan — thanks for the heads up and for looping Daniel in. We can definitely support a transition to AWS Marketplace for the renewal; the exact path depends on whether you want a SKU-mapped conversion or an amended direct-to-marketplace listing.

High-level proposed plan (we'll walk through on the call):
1) SKU mapping & pricing check — map current commitment to marketplace SKUs and confirm price parity or identify required amendment for credits/discounts. (Owner: Ben)
2) Procurement & legal alignment — outline whether a simple renewal + marketplace invoice change is sufficient or if we need an amendment signed via DocuSign. (Owner: Vanessa + Legal)
3) Entitlements & HubSpot mapping — ensure marketplace entitlements match your current contract so usage is reflected correctly. (Owner: Grace + Ops)
4) Pilot invoice cutover — choose a test invoice date and coordinate PO update with Daniel. (Owner: Finance Ops)
5) Final cutover & monitoring — verify invoices route correctly and confirm reporting to Arcadia finance. (Owner: Grace)

I've attached our internal \"marketplace-conversion-playbook.pdf\" which outlines required artifacts and the typical timeline. Can you confirm whether July 15 is the target cutover or if you have flexibility?

I have availability next week on Thursday 5/27 10:30–11:00 AM PT or Friday 5/28 9:00–9:30 AM PT — does either work for you and Daniel?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachment: marketplace-conversion-playbook.pdf (stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Arcadia Marketplace conversion — follow-up & owners (internal)

Team — quick internal recap and action items after this morning's call with Arcadia (Megan + Daniel present). Thread: Renewal billing: convert Arcadia Health to Marketplace for upcoming renewal.

Summary / decisions:
- Arcadia wants cutover to Marketplace by July 15 (renewal effective date). PO: PO-45678.
- They are open to an amendment only if necessary to preserve committed rates. Finance is sensitive to any perceived price change.
- We agreed to pilot a single invoice routing change for August invoice (test invoice) before closing out July subscription reporting.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Ben Carter: Complete SKU mapping and confirm price parity or propose amendment credit. Deliverable: SKU mapping spreadsheet. Due: 2027-06-24.
- Grace O'Connor: Prepare entitlements mapping and confirm HubSpot + billing entitlements alignment; run a dry-run with Ops. Deliverable: entitlement_report.pdf and monitoring checklist. Due: 2027-06-28.
- Legal / Vanessa: Prepare a short amendment template if Ben identifies a price delta that requires credit/adjustment. Start DocuSign workflow once Arcadia confirms. Target to have amendment ready by 2027-06-30.
- Finance Ops: Coordinate test invoice routing with AWS Marketplace team (internal) and confirm recognition impacts. Point of contact: finance-ops@redwood.com.

Risks / flags:
- If we cannot preserve committed pricing on Marketplace SKUs, revenue recognition and customer satisfaction may be impacted — escalate pricing exceptions to leadership if necessary.
- Timeline is tight; need Ben & Grace to prioritize their deliverables this week.

Attachments: arcadia-map-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub)

I'll pathway the amendment to Legal if Ben surfaces a mismatch. Ben — can you confirm you have the historic pricing details and will reach out to our Marketplace SKU team today? Grace — I'll set up a dry-run with Ops for Tuesday 6/29.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
